name: ghost-firebase-deploy
description: Deploy helper for the Ghost System portfolio on Firebase Hosting.

interface.shortDescription: Build, preflight, preview, and deploy the portfolio to Firebase.
interface.longDescription: A project-local deployment assistant for the Ghost System portfolio. It runs the existing Firebase preflight checks, builds the Next.js app, deploys preview channels, and delegates production deploys to the repository's canonical deploy script.
defaultPrompt: Run a Firebase deploy preflight for my portfolio.
Create a Firebase Hosting preview channel.
Deploy my portfolio to Firebase production.
